title: On the First Derivative Bounds for Rational Bézier Curves
summary: In this paper we investigate sharp upper bounds for the first derivative of rational Bézier curves. A long-standing conjecture posited that the linear bound $\|\mathbf{R}'(t)\| \le nΩ\max\|Δ_i\|$ holds for all degrees. We prove that the bound is indeed valid for $n \leq 6$, thus resolving the last open low-degree case. The problem is reformulated as maximizing a variance-like function over a compact box.
